impeccable.name: Glowing shadow accents
impeccable.description: Colored glow shadows — a zero-offset chromatic halo (box- or text-shadow) on any background, or any colored blurred shadow on a dark background — are the default "cool" look of AI-generated UIs. Use neutral elevation shadows and subtle, purposeful lighting instead.
impeccable.snippet: Colored box-shadow glow (#13203d) on dark page
